lines.text: The writer rejoices in his sufferings for the church, whose servant he became by God's commission.
God's commission was to fully proclaim His word, the mystery now made known among the Gentiles: Christ in you.
Paul proclaims Christ and teaches everyone with all wisdom, so that he may present everyone free in Christ.
He struggles for the Colossians and those at Ephesus, that they be knit together in love.
He writes so no one deceives them by smooth rhetoric, and he is absent in body but present in spirit.
